findings.reason: the endpoint as written deletes a possibly live worker's tree on an unreadable liveness probe, so the plan needs "unknown or unqueryable liveness keeps the run" stated and an arm that shows the release withholding it.
findings.text: s29's Deliverable states "A turn is read as in progress only while its process is alive", but the release's busy check already answers not-busy once a recorded process is proved dead (`reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:400-402`) and answers "in progress" only when liveness is unknown, because a record naming no process and an unqueryable scheduler both deliberately answer unknown (`reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:463-465,478-483`); read as written the rule converts that unknown into "not in progress", so a promoted run whose worker sits on a scheduler the fleet cannot query has its worktree released while the worker may still be alive, and none of s29's kept cases covers that state

findings.reason: a rule keyed on an unrecorded kind is neither implementable nor checkable, and a guessed classification silently decides which population is released.
findings.text: "A promoted run of a kind that is never merged is released on its promotion alone", and the third fixture's "promoted measurement run", rest on a run kind the system does not record: the run roles are implement, cleanup, review, investigate, test and documentation (`reckon/crew/ticker.py:669`; `reckon/evidence.py:712`), and no pointer or promotion row field marks a run as never merged, so the worker must invent which recorded fact names that population and the fixture has no measured field value to build it from

findings.reason: the arm reports the fleet's churn rather than the delivered decision, so the author may leave it and a worker can record the population it finds instead.
findings.text: the arm "The node's manifest records a read-only evaluation of the new release decision against three named live runs of this fleet, each reading as releasable" cannot be produced once those three runs leave the fleet, and s29's own Why records that nothing retires them "until someone discards it by hand"
